reference_rules: Keep the prose18N and caption18.5N core-coordinate conventions as distinct records; never average or interpret them as physical extrema.

sampling_rules: A-F are selected maxima of variability on six altimeter tracks; they are not route vertices.

Nearest-shore distances are not widths. Table1 bathymetry is seabed depth, not current thickness or analysis depth.

Theoretical Ro/2 values are source comparisons, not additional observations or numerical error margins.
No inference of finite fixed-depth slab or positional uncertainty.

Append only new reference rows, sampling rows, spectral rows and nonconflicting source definitions. Same-DOI different IDs require explicit reconciliation.
